name: Non-Skin / Background Object
description: The uploaded photograph does not appear to show human skin, or the image may be out-of-focus, blurry, or showing clothing, paper, or everyday objects.
common_symptoms: Image does not display skin texture, pores, or biological lesions
Subject is clothing, background, furniture, or a non-skin item
causes: Photo taken from too far away
Camera focused on clothing, room background, or foreign object
Extreme blurriness or lighting glare preventing skin analysis
first_aid: Please retake the photo in a well-lit room
Hold the camera steady 10 to 15 centimeters from the skin lesion
Ensure the camera focuses directly on the skin spot, not your clothing or the background
precautions: Avoid camera flash glare directly on the spot
Take photos against clean natural lighting
Make sure the area of skin is in sharp focus
home_care: Retake a clear, focused photograph showing only the skin area of concern
do_not: DO NOT upload photos of clothing, documents, or distant room objects
DO NOT use digital filters or editing on health photos
DO NOT rely on blurred photographs for health awareness
red_flags: If you have a real physical skin symptom that worries you, do not delay seeing a healthcare provider in person
when_to_see_doctor: If you have an actual concerning skin spot, please visit a doctor or health clinic directly for an in-person skin examination.
prevention: Always take well-lit, close-up photos of clean skin
